title: RzmLib
description: 认真猫系列模组的核心前置库，为其他 Rzm 模组提供支持 / The core dependency for the Rzm (SeriousCat) mod series, providing support for other Rzm mods.
body:
本模组是认真猫系列模组的核心前置轻量库，为其他 Rzm 模组提供底层支持。  
如果你想使用 RzmYsid 等模组，则必须安装本前置模组，否则这些模组将无法正常运行。  

**功能包括：**
- 按键输入与 Client-Server 订阅系统  
- 玩家形态渲染替换  
- 认真猫常用的自定义 HUD  
- 环绕实体系统  
- 粒子与视觉特效支持  
- /rzm 命令框架  
- 常用工具与辅助 API  

---

This mod is a lightweight core library for the RZMAO (Serious Cat) mod series, providing foundational support for other "Rzm" mods.  

If you want to use mods such as RzmYsid, you must install this library; otherwise, those mods will not function properly.  

**Features include:**
- Key input and client–server synchronization system  
- Player morph rendering replacement  
- Custom HUD elements commonly used in SeriousCat mods  
- Orbiting entity system  
- Particle and visual effects support  
- /rzm command framework  
- Common utilities and helper APIs  ****
